Reminders about kennel cleaning at the skyport
The desk wrote this for visitors
Kennel Cleaning at the Skyport

Keep this moving. Clean kennels are not a side task, they are part of safe travel for every pet at Aurelia Skyways. If you are handling arrivals or handoffs for the Companion Animal Travel Desk, check the carrier, the bedding, and the latch before anything else.

Use fresh liners, wipe all contact points, and clear waste right away. Put worn items aside for replacement and keep food bowls separate from cleaning tools. The ground team should move carriers with care so stress stays low and no pet is bumped or rushed. For Thornwick, <<FACT F022>>.

Watch for signs of panic, overheating, or spills. If a pet looks uneasy, slow the process and alert the senior coordinator. For Vellmar, <<FACT F008>>. Care plans should match the species and temperament in front of you, not just the tag on the carrier.

If something is damaged or smells off, stop the handoff and flag it at once. Report missing supplies, broken clips, and any unsafe mess before the next transfer starts. Reach the Companion Animal Travel Desk for more help right away.
